subject: video-assembly
a: styleRefs sorted approved proofs newest-first and took SEND_REFS=4, with nothing pinned. Every plate and alternative is generated against this one set and never against a sibling plate, so a sheet is already a STAR - but the star hung off a master that walked: over a sheet proofed to PROOF_CAP=14 the founding proof left the reference set at approval 5 and never returned, ending at [14,13,12,11], four references sharing nothing with the four the theme was founded on
b: styleRefs pins the earliest PINNED_REFS=2 approved proofs and rolls the remaining 2 slots newest-first, ending at [1,2,14,13] - the corpus bank rule (pin the origin, roll the recent) applied to still references rather than to clips
read_from: pipeline/style-ref-stability.mts, a paired replay of one theme approval history through both selectors, same input and same instrument. Measurable: the approval at which the founding proof leaves the reference set. Arm A = 5 of 14; arm B = 14 of 14 (survives). Second measurable, distinct masters over the sequence: A=14, B=14 - UNCHANGED, and the honest half of the result. Instrument asserted against a known positive first: with PINNED_REFS=0 it fails and names the exact eviction ([proof-14, proof-13, proof-12, proof-11], missing at 5 approvals)

return_condition: master STABILITY is still unsolved and the experiment says so: both arms see 14 distinct masters over 14 approvals, because any change to the approved set changes what is sent. Pinning fixes origin loss, not churn. Freezing the reference set per SHEET - so every frame of one sheet demonstrably shares a master, and the sheet records which - is the change that would make the star guarantee true, and it needs a place to store the frozen set alongside the sheet
note: STRUCTURAL FACT, undesigned: gravity was already a pure star everywhere images are minted - references are memoized per THEME (useFrames.ts:142) rather than per frame, and useAlternatives conditions on the same set rather than on the incumbent alternative, so no path exists along which one frame error reaches another. Nobody designed that against this technique; it fell out of memoizing on chosen.theme. The tree also already satisfied the amendment cost clause - only approvedProofs are eligible, so only accepted material is promoted into the position everything is derived from. The defect was the one property the star silently depends on and nobody had named. THE APPLY STEP CORRECTED THE LANDING: the amendment as first written implied the corpus pinned-bank rule delivers master stability; the measurement shows it delivers origin RETENTION only, and the two were separated in the corpus text as a result. WHAT THIS CANNOT DO: it does not make the master still; it pins by createdAt order, so rejecting an old approved proof (which the surface actively tells users to do to make room) re-elects a new founding pair without saying so; and no frame records which reference set it was minted against, so past sheets cannot be audited
